name: Foreman Grettir
title: Foreman of the Mine Yard
examine: Stone dust in every seam of him. He counts his crews out and counts them back, and the counting is the whole of his religion.
lines: Helmets on past the rope line. Yes, you.
The upper vein? We don't discuss the upper vein. It and I have an arrangement and you're not in it.
Every crew goes down on my count and comes up on my count. Twenty years, the numbers have matched. There was a time before that. We don't discuss that either.
